faq.q: Is a free account the same as Mail Club?
faq.a: No. A free account saves your profile. Paid Mail Club membership is separate and starts only after payment is confirmed.
Shipping dates will be published by the owner — we don’t invent dates here.

faq.q: Can I shop without joining Mail Club?
faq.a: Evet. Sticker ve shop tek seferliktir. Snail Mail Club paketi bir kez ödenir; postası bu fiyata dahildir.
